Tip for `mem_ballWithin_one_of_adj` and `mem_ballWithin_one_self`:
You can prove them in 1 line using your existing lemmas!
```lean
lemma mem_ballWithin_one_of_adj {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (c u : V) (hadj : G.Adj c u) :
    u ∈ ballWithin G 1 c := by
  have p : G.Walk c u := SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hadj SimpleGraph.Walk.nil
  exact mem_ballWithin_of_walk G p

lemma mem_ballWithin_one_self {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (c : V) :
    c ∈ ballWithin G 1 c :=
  ballWithin_subset_succ G 0 c (Finset.mem_singleton_self c)
```
This avoids unfolding `ballWithin` and worrying about `insert c ...`!
